mapper.select: select m.id, m.program_id, m.major_id, m.department_id, d.name as department_name, m.level, m.name, m.name_cn, m.sort_order from nad_program_major m left join nad_department d on d.id = m.department_id where m.program_id = #{programId} order by m.sort_order asc, m.id asc
